meta.name: Land of Sin
meta.description: When a teenager goes missing, a detective with personal ties to the case joins a tense investigation that reveals fierce loyalties and old family feuds.

videos.title: You've Been Warned
videos.overview: Malmö detectives Dani and Malik pay an unwelcome visit to a rural village to investigate the disappearance of a teenager — only for Dani, it's personal.

videos.title: Unidentified Man #1
videos.overview: Questions mount in the case as fresh evidence and buried secrets surface. Dani and Malik pursue multiple leads to track down an unknown suspect.

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: Malik bends the rules to help a heartbroken colleague deal with a painful prospect. Elis confronts a menacing figure from his past.

videos.title: Järven
videos.overview: While Järven issues an ultimatum to secure his safety, Elis forms an unlikely alliance to prove a potentially dangerous theory.

videos.title: Queen Bee
videos.overview: As unsettling new evidence and hard truths come to light, both police and locals scramble to find those responsible — before it's too late.
